constraints.constraint: All external API calls must be made from backend only (not client-side) for security
Test connection must have 10-second timeout as per architecture standards
All user actions must be logged to audit log (backend handles this)
Credentials must never be exposed in frontend logs or console
Test result does NOT block import flow - it's advisory only
OAuth2 testing requires access token to be available (cannot perform full flow)
Test endpoint selection must skip paths with required parameters or required request bodies
Minimum 80% code coverage for new components
Files must not exceed 500 lines (project standard)
Use existing form patterns from ImportConfig.tsx (React Hook Form + Zod)

api.name: POST /api/v1/tools/test-connection
api.response: { success: boolean, status_code?: number, response_time_ms: number, headers?: object, body?: string, error?: string, tested_endpoint?: string }
api.notes: Backend makes actual HTTP call to target API with 10s timeout, returns test results

interface.name: AuthConfig
interface.signature: type AuthConfig = { auth_type: 'none' | 'api_key' | 'bearer' | 'basic' | 'oauth2', api_key?: string, bearer_token?: string, username?: string, password?: string, oauth2_client_id?: string, oauth2_client_secret?: string, oauth2_token_url?: string, oauth2_scopes?: string[], access_token?: string }

tests.standards: Use React Testing Library for component tests. Use MSW (Mock Service Worker) for integration tests. Minimum 80% code coverage for new code. Test loading states, error states, and success states separately. Follow testing patterns from Story 30 (ScopeCheckboxGroup achieved 100% coverage with 21/21 tests passing).
